question: What audio output formats does the text-to-speech API endpoint support?
ground_truth: The ElevenLabs text-to-speech API supports multiple output formats specified via the output_format query parameter. Supported formats include: MP3 variants (mp3_22050_32, mp3_24000_48, mp3_44100_32, mp3_44100_64, mp3_44100_96, mp3_44100_128, mp3_44100_192), PCM formats (pcm_8000, pcm_16000, pcm_22050, pcm_24000, pcm_32000, pcm_44100, pcm_48000), μ-law format (ulaw_8000), A-law format (alaw_8000), and Opus formats (opus_48000_32, opus_48000_64, opus_48000_96, opus_48000_128, opus_48000_192). The format is structured as codec_sample_rate_bitrate. Note: MP3 192kbps requires Creator tier or above, and PCM 44.1kHz requires Pro tier or above.
